Nikolai Sorokin  
Munich, Germany | +49 176 123 4567 | n.sorokin@virtuemart.com  

A seasoned platform engineer with 14 years of experience in e-commerce infrastructure, specializing in scalable systems and cloud-native solutions. Focused on optimizing reliability, cost efficiency, and developer workflows through pragmatic engineering and cross-team collaboration.  

**Professional Experience**  
*Staff Platform Engineer*  
**VirtueMart** | 2017–Present  
- Spearheaded architecture for AWS-based microservices, reducing infrastructure costs by 22% through targeted resource optimization and automation.  
- Led Kubernetes cluster management across 12 environments, improving deployment reliability and reducing incident resolution times by 15%.  
- Designed CI/CD pipelines integrating GitHub Actions and Terraform, streamlining release cycles and enabling 3x faster feature rollouts.  
- Mentored junior engineers on cloud best practices, contributing to a 20% reduction in operational overhead across teams.  

*Senior Site Reliability Engineer*  
**RetailCloud** | 2013–2017  
- Built monitoring systems using Prometheus/Grafana, achieving 99.95% SLA compliance for critical services.  
- Implemented load balancing strategies that improved peak traffic handling capacity by 40% during seasonal sales.  
- Redesigned logging infrastructure to centralize logs across services, reducing debugging time by 30%.  
- Collaborated with DevOps teams to migrate legacy systems to Docker, reducing deployment complexity and improving scalability.  

*DevOps Engineer*  
**Ecomify** | 2010–2013  
- Automated deployment workflows using Jenkins, reducing manual intervention in CI/CD pipelines by 50%.  
- Optimized AWS cost structures for 3 high-traffic applications, achieving a 18% reduction in annual cloud spend.  
- Pioneered infrastructure-as-code practices, ensuring consistent environments across development, staging, and production.  

**Projects**  
- **Global Inventory Sync System** (VirtueMart, 2021–Present): Architected a distributed system using AWS Lambda and DynamoDB, improving inventory accuracy by 95% and reducing reconciliation time by 60%.  
- **Real-Time Analytics Dashboard** (RetailCloud, 2016): Developed a scalable analytics platform using Kinesis and Redshift, enabling real-time insights for 10+ retail clients.  
- **Serverless CI/CD Pipeline** (Ecomify, 2012): Redesigned internal CI/CD to leverage AWS CodePipeline, cutting deployment latency by 40%.  

**Technical Skills**  
- **Cloud Platforms**: AWS (architecture, cost optimization, EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda)  
- **DevOps Tools**: Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Terraform, Prometheus/Grafana, Kubernetes  
- **System Administration**: Linux (CentOS, Ubuntu), load balancing (Nginx, HAProxy), monitoring (Datadog, CloudWatch)  
- **Programming**: Python (scripting), Shell (automation)  
- **Containers**: Docker, container orchestration (Kubernetes)  
- **CI/CD**: GitHub Actions, Jenkins, infrastructure-as-code (Terraform)

*Bachelor of Science in Computer Science*  
National University of Computing | 2010
